sn35.108:1.1: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa Seyyoham asmī ti vā hoti || Sadiso ham asmī ti vā hoti || Hīnohamasmī ti vā hotī ti || ||
sn35.108:2.1: Bhagavaṃ mūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe || ||
sn35.108:3.1: Cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhum upādāya cakkhum abhinivissa Seyyo ham asmī ti vā hoti || Sadīso ham asmī ti vā hoti Hīno ham asmī ti vā hoti || pa || Manasmiṃ sati manam upādāya manam abhinivissa Seyyo ham asmī ti vā hoti || Sadiso ham asmī ti vā hoti || Hīno ham asmī ti vā hoti || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || Cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.108:5.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.108:7.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu tam anupādāya Seyyo ham asmīti vā assa Sadiso ham asmīti vā assa Hīno ham asmīti vā assāti
sn35.108:10.1: Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.108:12.1: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.108:14.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya Seyyo hamasmīti va assa Sadiso ham asnū ti vā assa Hīno ham asmīti assā ti || ||
sn35.108:16.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || la || manasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || ||
